author: Grimes, Charles E.; Grimes, Barbara D.
title: Languages of South Sulawesi
notes: Consulted directly on 25 November 2026 (Internet Archive scan in Downloads, OCR text layer). A lexicostatistical survey (202-item list, 39 word lists collected November 1982 to March 1983); classification in Figure 5 (pp. 15-18) and chapter 3: a South Sulawesi Stock of five divisions, the Makassar Subfamily, the Bugis Family, the Northern South Sulawesi Family (with the Toraja-Sa'dan and Masenrempulu Subfamilies), the Seko Family and Lemolang (p. 23); a Central Sulawesi Stock and a Muna-Buton Stock (Laiyolo, Bonerate, Kalaotoa, Wotu). Phonetic notes on single languages pp. 94-97; word lists Appendix E.
series: Pacific Linguistics D-78; Materials in Languages of Indonesia 38
